name: stunning-red-dress-blonde-cinematic-portrait
image_vibe: Elegant red suede styling, dirty-blonde waves, soft cinematic light, and textured beige minimalism
image_purpose: Create a refined cinematic fashion lookbook or campaign portrait.

prompt.project_info: A hyper-realistic 9:16 medium portrait of an original adult woman against a textured beige plaster wall.
prompt.main_subject: An original adult woman with wavy dirty-blonde hair and striking green eyes, wearing a fitted red suede dress with a square neckline and subtle floral inner trim. Give her an elegant composed expression and natural authentic skin texture.
prompt.composition_elements: Medium portrait framing, subject positioned against a textured beige plaster wall, red dress as the color focal point, wavy hair framing the face, and a simple cinematic fashion hierarchy.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft cinematic directional lighting with gentle shadow modeling, shallow depth of field, warm beige wall texture, quiet polished fashion mood, and natural skin contrast.
prompt.technical_specs: Vertical 9:16 composition, 35mm photography style, high-resolution 8K-style realism, detailed suede, floral trim, hair, plaster, and skin texture, subtle film grain, natural optical falloff, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a hyper-realistic vertical 9:16 medium fashion portrait of an original adult woman with wavy dirty-blonde hair and striking green eyes, wearing a fitted red suede dress with a square neckline and subtle floral inner trim. Pose her elegantly against a textured beige plaster wall. Use soft cinematic lighting, shallow depth of field, a 35mm photography style, authentic natural skin texture, detailed suede, floral trim, hair, and plaster, subtle film grain, natural optical falloff, high-resolution 8K-style clarity, and no text or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, minor or teen-coded subject, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, malformed dress, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, cartoon, illustration, 3D render, anime, low quality, blurry, watermark, text

assets.name: source red suede cinematic portrait
assets.usage: Use only as optional guidance for dirty-blonde waves, green eyes, red suede dress, beige plaster wall, 35mm look, and soft cinematic light; do not copy identity.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Preserve the original adult fashion subject, red suede dress, square neckline, floral trim, beige plaster wall, medium portrait, and cinematic mood. Identity and non-essential details may vary.
